name: orchestration-mode
description: Task Orchestrator in the session itself: a band above the prompt with the graph this session drives, in plain words (its title with a per-member bar where each agent's item blinks in its own colour, what needs a look and what the agents do, one row per agent; its own runs, else the item it is working on), toggleable with /to-band; a footer label always naming the mode (orchestrator at rest, director, coordinator); a tinted desktop backdrop and toasts (early-access function-hooks API)

band.title: Graph band
band.description: Draw the band above the prompt with the progression of the graph this session drives, in every mode; the default for every session. /to-band hides the band for this session (survives a reload); the footer label shows either way.

backdrop.title: Mode backdrop
backdrop.description: Tint the desktop app's backdrop while this session is in director or coordinator mode. The footer label and toasts show either way.

apiUrl.title: Task Orchestrator REST API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL of the server's REST API; the band reads POST <apiUrl>/api/v1/ops/director/<tool>. Leave empty to read over the director MCP connection instead (stdio servers).
